## Checklist

- [ ] The pipeline is green, and the commands of "Run the checks" in the maintainer guide pass locally.
- [ ] Each "Done when" item has evidence: a command output, a test name or a link.
- [ ] The diff stays within the issue and within its size label. A larger diff means stop and split.
- [ ] The docs that the change affects are updated, the generated architecture page included.
- [ ] No secret is committed.
- [ ] A new dependency has a reason written in this pull request.
- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits, and the body says `Closes #n`.
